### The One-Flesh Union
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/one-flesh-union
Passage: Mark 10:7-9
Points:
- Society frequently treats marriage as a dispensable arrangement of convenience.
- First-century religious leaders twisted Moses' law to permit divorce over trivial matters.
- God established marriage at creation as an enduring union between complementary partners.
- Because God unites husband and wife, humans must not separate them for unbiblical reasons.
- Pastors and church elders are needed to protect the wronged and apply Scripture with justice.
